Title: Public preview: WordPress enhancements for App Service

Body.Content:
New capabilities for WordPress on App Service for Linux are now in public preview from the Azure marketplace.

These updates offer significant performance improvements, more flexible hosting options, and enhanced configuration:

  • By optimizing areas such as caching and image compression, this release offers a 10x improvement in read response time, a 2x improvement in write response time, and 80% reduction in resource utilization.
  • Four hosting plans give you flexibility to choose an option that best reflects your requirements.
  • Configuration simply requires creation of a username and password – everything else is taken care of for you.

You’ll find additional details in this blog post.
